capabilities.title: Memoz task flow
capabilities.description: Find the active task from the project's .memoz/tasks.json declaration and work on exactly one. Use when starting, continuing or closing work in a project tracked with Memoz. Never guesses where work lives.

capabilities.title: Memoz closure writer
capabilities.description: Write the closure record when a piece of work finishes: what changed, decisions and rejected options, measurements with their conditions, falsified assumptions, and criteria that could not be closed. Use when finishing a task, sub-task or release. Refuses to close on a missing field.
